rows.text:
The three faces of Paranirmitavaśavartin, and the true appearance of the Lord Ravager that wields authority over all possibilities.
All things in myriad forms pass through "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay," until they turn to "Annihilation." Elation and time are mortal enemies. Beneath the endless erosion of the ages, all things shall fade into silence.
To execute the Sky's decree of the Destruction, fulfilling the ambition of extinguishing all minds who bear emotions in the world.
